description: This file contains utility functions for generating table headers and CSV data for user tables in a web application, including handling of header filtering, header validation, and CSV row creation with user attributes.

methods.name: generateHeaderFromReactTable
methods.description: Generates table header names from a React Table instance, excluding certain columns and adding a 'Link' column after 'Members'.

methods.name: generateCsvRawForMembersTable
methods.description: Creates a CSV string for a members table, validating headers, and formatting user data and attributes into CSV rows.
